title: WeerwolvenMC
description: A dutch game but then in minecraft!
body:
The **WeerwolvenMC** Plugin is a uniquely crafted, Dutch-developed gameplay expansion designed specifically for Minecraft servers that want to bring the intense, mysterious, and strategic world of the classic “Werewolves” party game into the Minecraft universe. Built with precision, care, and a deep understanding of the atmosphere that makes the original game so engaging, this plugin transforms any Minecraft server into a living, breathing stage for deception, teamwork, and survival.

At its core, the plugin provides a strong foundation for structured gameplay during both day and night cycles. One of its most defining features is the automatic night-sleep system, which ensures all players are instantly placed in their beds when the Minecraft world enters nighttime. This not only adds immersion to the Werewolf theme, but also guarantees that the server transitions smoothly between the crucial phases of the game. Because nighttime is traditionally when the werewolves take action, automatic forced sleeping creates a stable environment where players cannot avoid or disrupt the rhythm of the game.

During forced sleep, players cannot leave their beds unless authorized. A special command, /bed-free, allows staff or game operators to release individual players from forced sleep if needed. This command-based override adds flexibility and control, helping server hosts manage custom scenarios, special events, or unique role-based behaviors.

Beyond the sleep system, the WeerwolvenMC plugin introduces survival restrictions tailored to encourage fair play and structured behavior. Players in survival mode lose the ability to place or break most blocks, preventing them from building unfair defenses or destroying important play areas. However, essential containers—such as chests, barrels, and shulker boxes—remain fully usable. This encourages careful item management without disrupting the environment or the flow of the game. These restrictions help maintain the tension and strategic nature of the Werewolf experience, while still preserving standard interactive features like inventory organization and item storage.

Another central aspect of the plugin is role immersion. While the plugin does not force roles by itself (this can be handled by server operators, datapacks, or additional plugins), it does create an environment that supports role-based play. Players can be assigned roles such as villagers, detectives, healers, or of course, werewolves. Because nighttime actions are tightly controlled through forced sleeping and restricted movement, it becomes significantly easier to host organized role rounds, discussions, special events, or secret actions.

Being built by Dutch developers, the plugin carries a design philosophy rooted in clarity, safety, and community friendliness. Dutch Minecraft communities often emphasize structured group play, logical interaction, and respect for the original gaming experience. These values are reflected directly in the plugin’s design choices: minimal invasiveness, well-thought-out restrictions, compatibility with Paper servers, and easy-to-read code that can be extended or modified by developers.

The plugin is also designed with server performance in mind. Its systems run on light, efficient loops that check game time at safe intervals, ensuring minimal performance impact even on busy servers. Events such as block breaking, placing, or leaving beds only trigger when necessary—there are no heavy tick-based calculations, meaning the plugin scales well for small private servers and larger community hubs alike.

For administrators and plugin developers, the codebase is simple, clean, and predictable. The automatic forced-sleep task runs once per second, avoiding unnecessary load, and survival restrictions rely on straightforward event listeners. Everything is written to be understandable and editable, allowing advanced users or server owners to modify behavior to fit their community's needs. This makes the WeerwolvenMC plugin not only a ready-to-use package but also a flexible foundation for further development.

In addition to its gameplay features, the plugin helps establish atmosphere. The strict day/night cycle control encourages players to gather during the day for discussions, accusations, planning, and cooperative tasks. Then, as darkness falls, the immediate forced-sleep mechanic forces a pause in player movement and opens a window for hidden actions, secret commands, or role-specific tasks. This pacing mirrors the structure of the original Werewolves party game, making the plugin perfect for servers that want to recreate the psychological tension of suspicion and strategy.

Because the plugin is Dutch-developed, it was created with multilingual communities in mind. While the internal code and user-facing messages are in English by default, all text can be customized or translated easily to support Dutch, English, or other languages. This makes it an ideal tool for both local Dutch servers and international communities seeking a polished, professional gameplay experience influenced by Dutch design principles.

From a community standpoint, WeerwolvenMC encourages players to interact, think critically, and collaborate. The plugin does not attempt to overshadow the server with unnecessary features—it enhances the base game in a way that feels natural, cohesive, and intuitive. Whether used for large public events, small group sessions, or long-term role-based worlds, the plugin adapts to the community’s needs.

Overall, the WeerwolvenMC Official Plugin is more than just a gameplay add-on. It is a carefully constructed toolkit for creating structured, immersive, role-based adventures inspired by the Werewolves tradition. With features like forced bedtime cycles, survival restrictions, command-based overrides, and a design philosophy rooted in Dutch game culture, it provides a complete foundation for servers looking to deliver tense, mysterious, and memorable experiences.

Stable, customizable, lightweight, and designed for serious roleplay—WeerwolvenMC is the perfect choice for any server host who wants to elevate their Minecraft world into a dynamic stage of suspense, teamwork, deception, and strategy.
